title: Arbiter Power-On Bias — No Reset on Priority Pointer
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] last_gnt=2'bxx at power-on; biased arbitration for first 100 cycles
rtl: logic [1:0] last_gnt;  // No reset — indeterminate at power-on
expected_root_cause: The priority pointer last_gnt is declared without an always_ff reset branch; its power-on value is 2'bxx (indeterminate), biasing the round-robin arbitration toward whichever master index the garbage value happens to match.
description: The priority pointer has no reset assignment; its power-on value is indeterminate, which can permanently bias arbitration toward whichever master happens to match the garbage initial value.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] last_gnt=2'bxx at power-on; biased arbitration for first 100 cycles
success_log: last_gnt=2'h0 after reset. Unbiased round-robin from first arbitration cycle.
